title: A geometric approach to nonlocal 2-Hessian equations
summary: We study a nonlocal 2-Hessian equation, given by an infimum of linear deformations of the fractional Laplacian, that is, $\inf_{A\in {A}_2}Δ^s (u\circ A)(A^{-1}x)$. We characterize the class of coefficient matrices ${A}_2$, which determines the behavior of the operator, and provide a detailed geometric description of the possible degeneracies. Our main theorem shows that the nonlocal 2-Hessian equation remains uniformly elliptic for strictly positive right-hand sides, which leads to regularity estimates.
